question: For each conference id, what are their names, year, and number of participants?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conferences" AS SELECT "conference_id" AS "conference_id", "confname_year" AS "confname_year" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conference_staff" AS SELECT "conference_id" AS "conference_id", "staff_id" AS "staff_id" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE materializer_assumption_check AS
SELECT * FROM (
    VALUES
        ('conferences', 'conference_id, confname_year', 'conference_id, confname_year', NULL, NULL),
        ('conference_staff', 'conference_id, staff_id', 'conference_id, staff_id', NULL, NULL)
) AS t(table_name, actual_columns, expected_columns, missing_expected, unexpected_extra)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conferences AS
SELECT CAST(conference_id AS VARCHAR) AS conference_id,
       CAST(confname_year AS VARCHAR) AS confname_year
FROM conferences

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conference_staff AS
SELECT CAST(conference_id AS VARCHAR) AS conference_id,
       CAST(staff_id AS BIGINT) AS staff_id
FROM conference_staff

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH conf_parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(conference_id AS VARCHAR) AS conference_id,
        SPLIT_PART(confname_year, '#', 1) AS conference_name,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(confname_year, '#', 2) AS INTEGER) AS year
    FROM conferences
),
counts AS (
    SELECT CAST(conference_id AS VARCHAR) AS conference_id, COUNT(DISTINCT staff_id) AS participants
    FROM conference_staff
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    p.conference_id,
    p.conference_name,
    p.year,
    COALESCE(c.participants, 0) AS participants
FROM conf_parsed p
LEFT JOIN counts c USING (conference_id)
ORDER BY p.conference_id;

# Extract name and year from confname_year and count participants per conference
sql = '''

WITH conf_parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(conference_id AS VARCHAR) AS conference_id,
        SPLIT_PART(confname_year, '#', 1) AS conference_name,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(confname_year, '#', 2) AS INTEGER) AS year
    FROM conferences
),
counts AS (
    SELECT CAST(conference_id AS VARCHAR) AS conference_id, COUNT(DISTINCT staff_id) AS participants
    FROM conference_staff
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    p.conference_id,
    p.conference_name,
    p.year,
    COALESCE(c.participants, 0) AS participants
